designs.name: Modern cylinder
designs.description: A clean cylindrical wall light casts a soft up-and-down glow, making it a restrained choice for hallways and bedside walls.

designs.name: Pleated shade arm
designs.description: A pleated fabric shade softens the light while the short brass arm adds a classic, warm accent beside a bed or reading chair.

designs.name: Black cone arm
designs.description: The angled black cone directs light downward, useful for focused bedside or task lighting with a modern contrast finish.

designs.name: Clear glass bell
designs.description: A clear bell glass shade leaves the bulb visible and gives this brass wall fixture a light, vintage-inspired character.

designs.name: Linen shade arm
designs.description: A tapered linen shade diffuses light gently, pairing naturally with calm bedrooms and traditional interiors.

designs.name: Outdoor lantern
designs.description: A framed lantern enclosure protects the bulb visually and suits entryways, covered porches, or transitional spaces.

designs.name: Vertical glass tube
designs.description: A slim vertical glass tube creates a minimal architectural line for mirrors, corridors, or a matched bedside pair.

designs.name: Textured glass cylinder
designs.description: Textured glass scatters the light into a sparkling pattern, adding detail to a vanity wall or hospitality setting.

designs.name: Double globe
designs.description: Two opal globes spread light in opposite directions and create a balanced statement for a bedside or narrow wall.

designs.name: LED flush mount
designs.description: A low-profile round LED disc sits close to the ceiling and gives broad, even general illumination.

designs.name: Square LED light
designs.description: A square LED panel brings a crisp geometric outline to compact rooms, corridors, or modern utility spaces.

designs.name: Round LED light
designs.description: A classic round LED panel keeps the ceiling simple while providing an even, low-profile wash of light.

designs.name: Drum semi-flush
designs.description: A fabric drum shade hides the light source and softens the room with a warm semi-flush silhouette.

designs.name: Crystal semi-flush
designs.description: Layered crystal drops add sparkle beneath a compact ceiling mount, suited to a small entry or dressing area.

designs.name: Industrial cage
designs.description: An open metal cage leaves the bulbs visible and brings an industrial character to kitchens and relaxed living spaces.

designs.name: Modern Sputnik
designs.description: Radiating exposed bulbs create a Sputnik silhouette that works well as a sculptural focal point.

designs.name: Ring LED light
designs.description: A single glowing ring keeps the form minimal and distributes light around a clean circular outline.

designs.name: Modern loop light
designs.description: Interlocking illuminated loops create a contemporary sculptural centerpiece with an integrated-light look.

designs.name: Rattan semi-flush
designs.description: A woven rattan dome filters light through its natural texture for a relaxed, organic interior.

designs.name: Tiered drum light
designs.description: A stepped drum profile adds depth while keeping the light soft and mostly directed downward.

designs.name: Boho semi-flush
designs.description: A woven shade combines a rounded profile with natural texture and a warm decorative glow.

designs.name: Glass globe light
designs.description: A clear globe shows the bulb and its warm filament, giving a light, vintage-inspired ceiling accent.

designs.name: Geometric cage
designs.description: A cubic metal frame exposes several bulbs and gives the fixture a strong architectural outline.

designs.name: Globe flush mount
designs.description: An opal globe and compact brass mount create a simple diffused light for smaller rooms and hallways.

designs.name: Linear LED light
designs.description: A slim linear LED bar spreads light along its length, useful above a work surface or in a narrow passage.

designs.name: Geometric flush
designs.description: A faceted shade creates angular shadows and a graphic low-profile appearance on the ceiling.

designs.name: Mid-century light
designs.description: Multiple opal globes on brass arms provide an even, mid-century-inspired statement over a living area.

designs.name: Surface mount
designs.description: A short cylindrical surface mount directs light down from a compact, architectural form.

designs.name: Ribbed glass light
designs.description: Ribbed glass catches and refracts the bulb glow, adding texture to a compact ceiling fixture.

designs.name: Modern dish light
designs.description: Several shallow dishes distribute light in multiple directions while keeping the fixture close to the ceiling.

designs.name: Natural-fiber light
designs.description: A woven natural-fiber dome brings a relaxed handcrafted texture and a warm pool of light.

designs.name: Adjustable spotlight
designs.description: Adjustable heads let the light be aimed toward different task or accent areas in one room.

designs.name: Crystal flush mount
designs.description: A low crystal profile adds reflected sparkle while fitting beneath lower ceilings.

designs.name: Sculptural flush mount
designs.description: Overlapping light loops create a contemporary graphic form and an even ambient glow.

designs.name: Crystal chandelier
designs.description: Cascading crystal strands and candle-style lamps form a traditional centerpiece for a formal dining or reception room.

designs.name: Modern chandelier
designs.description: A spiral of illuminated rings gives this modern chandelier a fluid, sculptural presence above a dining table.

designs.name: Classic chandelier
designs.description: Curved arms, candle bulbs, and crystal drops give the classic silhouette a decorative, heritage-inspired look.

designs.name: Linear chandelier
designs.description: A row of glass-shielded lights spreads illumination along a table or kitchen island.

designs.name: Drum chandelier
designs.description: A broad drum shade frames several light points and helps soften the fixture over a dining area.

designs.name: Tiered chandelier
designs.description: Stacked circular tiers create a strong vertical profile suited to rooms with generous ceiling height.

designs.name: Cascading chandelier
designs.description: Suspended glass globes at varied heights create movement and a cascading focal point in stairwells or open rooms.

designs.name: Globe chandelier
designs.description: Opal globes arranged around a central frame give a balanced, softly diffused mid-century look.

designs.name: Sputnik chandelier
designs.description: A radial arrangement of exposed bulbs makes a bold starburst centerpiece for a living or dining room.

designs.name: Wagon-wheel chandelier
designs.description: A circular frame with evenly spaced lights suits long tables and open-plan dining areas.

designs.name: Mini chandelier
designs.description: A compact chandelier keeps the decorative effect in smaller bedrooms, entries, or breakfast nooks.

designs.name: Industrial chandelier
designs.description: Dark metal framing and exposed bulbs give the fixture an open, workshop-inspired character.

designs.name: Bohemian chandelier
designs.description: A woven shade creates a handcrafted focal point and filters light into a warm, textured pattern.

designs.name: Art Deco chandelier
designs.description: Layered geometric tiers and glowing panels create a structured Art Deco-inspired centerpiece.

designs.name: Nature-inspired chandelier
designs.description: Branching arms and leaf-like lights bring an organic, nature-inspired silhouette to a room.

designs.name: Ring chandelier
designs.description: A suspended luminous ring gives a clean contemporary outline above a table or central seating area.

designs.name: Bubble chandelier
designs.description: Clustered glass globes create a bright, reflective form with a sense of depth and movement.

designs.name: Disc chandelier
designs.description: Repeated flat discs build a layered arrangement with broad, gentle light distribution.

designs.name: Canopy chandelier
designs.description: A canopy of many small points creates a starry effect for high ceilings and spacious interiors.

designs.name: Sculptural chandelier
designs.description: A flowing continuous form turns the light fixture into a sculptural centerpiece.

hero.title: Light, shaped *around you*
hero.lede: The right light starts with your room, not with what happens to be on a shelf. LumaDesign brings design, preview and personal advice together, so the light you choose fits the way you live.

blocks.title: Every room has its own story
blocks.imageAlt: A ring chandelier glowing above a dining table
paragraphs: A bedroom wants a softer glow than a dining table. A home office needs clear, calm light. We start from the space and the people in it, then help you find or shape the light that suits them.
That is why LumaDesign is built around three simple ideas: see the options clearly, shape them to your taste, and see them in your own room before you decide.
blocks.quote: Light should feel as if it was chosen for the room, because it was.
